App.name: Corridor
App.tagline: Logistics, container tracking and fleet operations for the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor.

Home.opsDescription: Shipments, dispatch, fleet and the live map.

Area.notBuilt: This area is not built yet. Screens arrive in Phases 3–6.
Area.noData: No data. Nothing on this page comes from a real tenant.

Session.mfaRequired: Your role requires multi-factor authentication. Set up an authenticator app for your account, then sign in again. Until then this role has no permissions.
Session.noAccess: This account has no access to Corridor.
Session.noMembership: You are not a member of any company yet. Ask your company administrator for an invitation.
Session.membershipSuspended: Your access to this company is suspended.
Session.tenantSuspended: This company account is suspended. Contact Corridor support.
Session.wrongClient: Your role cannot use this area. Customers use the customer portal; drivers use the driver app.
Session.tenantNotFound: The selected company is not available to you.
Session.unreachable: The API cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
Session.sessionRejected: Your session is no longer valid.
Session.notPlatformAdmin: This area is for platform administrators only.
Session.signInFailedHelp: The sign-in could not be completed. Start again from the home page.
Session.mfaSetup: Set up your authenticator app now.

common.demoNote: Data entered here is real company data — do not enter test data in production.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.containerHint: Hold Ctrl/Cmd to select several. Only available containers are listed.

actions.clearanceNote: Only confirm clearance once customs has actually released the cargo. GPS arrival is not clearance.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.intro: Create a trip for confirmed shipments, assign a vehicle and a driver, and dispatch — in one step.

map.title: Live map
map.intro: Latest trusted position of each vehicle. Colours show how fresh each position is.
map.none: No vehicle has reported a position yet.
map.feedStale: Live updates are not arriving. The map shows the last data received at {time}; positions keep ageing.
map.basemap: Base map: development tiles. Production uses self-hosted tiles.

eta.title: Estimated arrival
eta.basis: {km} km left · based on the position recorded {at}
eta.noDestination: No ETA: the shipment has no destination point.
eta.none: No ETA yet (no trusted GPS position).

delivery.title: Confirm delivery
delivery.note: The photo and signature become visible to the customer once the delivery is confirmed.

links.title: Public tracking links
links.description: Anyone with a link sees only the fields you allow, with an approximate position (±1 km). Links expire and can be revoked.
links.label: Label
links.onlyOnce: For security, the link is shown only once. Revoke it and create a new one if it is lost.

geofences.title: Geofences and checkpoints
geofences.description: Areas used to detect checkpoint visits from GPS. A geofence starts unverified; only a verified border geofence can move a shipment to “at border”. Clearance is always confirmed by a person.
geofences.name: Name
geofences.verifyNote: Verify only after checking the outline matches the real place.
geofences.sourceHint: Where the position came from (survey, map, site visit).
geofences.newCheckpoint: Watch a geofence as a checkpoint
geofences.borderNote: Entering a verified border checkpoint records arrival only, never customs clearance.

containers.title: Containers
containers.numberHint: ISO 6346: 4 letters + 7 digits, e.g. MSCU1234566 (the last digit is checked).

team.title: Team
team.description: People who can sign in to this company, their roles, and the driver profile or customer company each driver and customer account belongs to.
team.noAccess: Only owners and admins can manage the team.
team.needsDriverProfile: Create a driver profile under Fleet first, then link it here.
team.needsCustomer: Create the customer first, then link it here.
team.name: Name
team.inviteNote: This sends a real email with a temporary password (from Cognito). Invite only addresses that belong to the person. Drivers and customers must then be linked to their driver profile or customer company in the table above.
team.invited: Invitation sent. The person signs in with the temporary password from the email.

trips.title: Trips
trips.description: Trips created by Dispatch. Open a trip to start, pause or complete it for the driver.
trips.empty: No trips yet. Confirm a shipment, then use Dispatch.
trips.onBehalfNote: You are acting for the driver: a reason is required and the action is recorded under your name. Live GPS positions come only from the driver app; starting the trip here opens tracking but no positions arrive until the driver app sends them.

Portal.title: My shipments
Portal.description: Shipments of your company with their latest status.

Track.heading: Shipment tracking
Track.etaNote: Estimate from the last trusted position; it can change.
Track.footer: This page shows only what the sender chose to share.
Track.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again in a minute.

Mfa.title: Set up your authenticator app
Mfa.intro: Your role needs two-step sign-in. You will add Corridor to an authenticator app on your phone, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
Mfa.scan: Open your authenticator app, choose “Add account” and scan this QR code.
Mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
Mfa.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually (time-based):
Mfa.openOnPhone: On this phone? Open in the authenticator app
Mfa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app:
Mfa.doneNext: Sign out and sign in again. From now on Cognito asks for a code from the app after your password.
Mfa.signInAgain: Sign out and sign in again
Mfa.signInFirst: Sign in first, then come back to this page.
Mfa.alreadyOn: Two-step sign-in is already on for your account.
Mfa.localNote: Local development: tick “TOTP MFA enrolled” on the development sign-in page instead.
Mfa.apps: Works with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy and other TOTP apps.

errors.invalid_code: Enter the 6 digits shown in the app.
errors.CodeMismatchException: That code did not match. Wait for the next code and try again.
errors.EnableSoftwareTokenMFAException: That code did not match. Wait for the next code and try again.
errors.NotAuthorizedException: Your session cannot change sign-in settings. Sign out, sign in again, then retry.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.local_issuer: Not available with the local development sign-in.
errors.unreachable: Could not reach the sign-in service. Try again.
